events.text: Read-only diagnosis against live reactjit-dev PID 3393746: RSS is real (3,249,660 KiB anonymous), but the panel mislabels all untracked host RSS as Native / driver and does not count native map or foliage buffers under World / Map. The dominant owner is whole-document live foliage expansion: roughly 17.0-17.24M grass rows plus 3.37-3.41M bush rows, 48 bytes each, retained in two ping-pong sets. Power-of-two growth leaves two 1.5GiB-capacity grass mappings and two 192MiB-capacity bush mappings, with about 1.83-1.89GiB resident. Add about 380.86MiB for 625 canonical chunks and 86.41MiB for the all-chunk foliage snapshot. No code changed.

resolution: Diagnosed the 3.27 GiB editor RSS without modifying code. The expanded map itself accounts for roughly 381 MiB; the dominant cost is the live foliage preview expanding every planted cell in all 625 chunks into millions of literal 48-byte instance rows and retaining two elastic ping-pong copies. Linux smaps confirms the resulting paired 1.5 GiB grass-capacity and 192 MiB bush-capacity mappings. The memory UI currently omits map chunks, foliage rows, and foliage snapshots from World / Map, then labels the entire unexplained remainder Native / driver, so its 21.4K attribution is misleading even though total RSS is accurate.
